issue.title: Mark source manifests published after feed retry succeeds
issue.description: A successful remote retry delivers an episode to the feed and removes its outbox entry, but leaves the source host's library manifest marked unpublished. Mark the source manifest after success and cover retry success/failure behavior with tests.

task_type_fields.impact: Published episodes remain labeled unpublished in the originating library, so local state disagrees with the feed and can mislead later status checks.
task_type_fields.repro: Queue an episode on Athena while Apollo is unavailable, restore Apollo, and run `sase listen publish --pending`. The outbox entry is removed and the feed receives the episode, but Athena’s library manifest retains `published: false`; the retry success path drops the outbox entry without calling mark_manifest_published.

issue.creation_reason: The feed was healthy and the outbox empty, but Athena's three delivered episodes still had published=false manifests. This follow-up tracks reconciling the source library after a successful pending retry.

payload.description: Verify the created follow-up captures the source manifest retry gap and evidence
